What’s Next?
This is a fresh open-source start. I will be working on it and pushing improvements on a daily basis. Very soon, with your testing and feedback, this project will reach its highly stable and optimal state.

changelog.name: WaEnhancerX-v1.6.9
changelog.body:
[Added]
- **WhatsApp Support**:
  - Full compatibility with WA/WB versions up to **2.26.23.xx**.
- **Floating Bottom Navigation Bar**:
  - Implemented a smooth floating pill-shaped bottom navigation bar with layout adjustments and transitions.
- **WaEnhancerX Pro Features**:
  - Introduced the premium license verification framework tied to device hardware (via Telegram bot `@waenhancerx_bot`).
  - **Always Typing [Pro]**: Added *Always Typing* and *Always Recording Voice* states.
  - **Message Bomber [Pro]**: Added a message-bombing utility with adjustable delays.
  - **Media Deletion [Pro]**: Added option to completely delete message media files directly from local storage.
  - **Status Splitter [Pro]**: Implemented a status video splitter with full obfuscation support to automatically post long status videos.
  - **Status View Customizations [Pro]**: Custom status playback controls, layouts, fast-forward/rewind gestures, playback speed controllers, play/pause buttons, and options to hide/disable reply bars, quick reactions, and heart buttons.
- **General Enhancements**:
  - Added option to make message text selectable inside chat bubbles.
  - Added toggle to hide the new Meta AI tab on the Home Screen.
  - Added user configuration to select between embedded settings inside WhatsApp or launch as an external standalone application.
  - Added a multi-step "Report Issue" flow with title input and validation checks.

[Improvements]
- **Database & Query Performance**:
  - Integrated a one-time database index optimization to resolve lags (especially when the *Separate Groups* feature is active).
  - Optimized conversation scrolling performance.
- **UX & Design Polish**:
  - Rounded custom bottom sheets and alert dialog buttons to match modern pill-shaped designs.
- **App Size Reduction**:
  - Decoupled `App.java` from licensing using dynamic reflection, purged verbose debug logs, and removed the unused native `DexKit` dependency to decrease package size.

[Fixes]
- **Media & Audio**:
  - Fixed sending local media files as voice notes and resolved transcoding issues with the Audio-to-Opus utility.
  - Fixed crashes in `AudioPlayerDialog` when loading corrupt or unplayable audio files.
- **Seen Ticks & Online Status**:
  - Resolved seen tick (Hide Blue Ticks) issues.
  - Fixed Hide Typing & Recording voice status hooks.
- **Compatibility & Crash Fixes**:
  - Resolved `MODE_WORLD_READABLE` exceptions in Xposed initialization.
  - Fixed nested preference fragment crashes and navigation errors.
  - Implemented fallback method-resolution logic in `Unobfuscator` for floating action button hook failures.
  - Restored chat date separators (Today, Yesterday, etc.) that were missing under time customization.

# WaEnhancer X **UI customization, automation, and privacy engine for WhatsApp on Android** WaEnhancer X is an open-source Xposed/LSPosed module for rooted Android that enhances WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business with privacy controls, anti-delete recovery, view-once media tools, interface customization, and productivity features—without repackaging the official app. 👉 [![Source Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/Source_Code-GitHub-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX) 👈 [![Android Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Android%20API%2024%2B-3DDC84?style=flat&logo=android&logoColor=white)](https://developer.android.com) [![Framework](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framework-LSPosed%20%7C%20Zygisk-orange?style=flat)](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPosed) [![WaEnhancerX Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/xposed-Modules-Repo/com.waenhancer/total.svg?label=LSPosed%20Repo%20Downloads&color=purple)](https://github.com/xposed-Modules-Repo/com.waenhancer/releases) [![Telegram](https://telegram-badge.pages.dev/api/telegram-badge?channelId=@waenhancerx&label=WaEnhancerX%20Updates&showOnline=true)](https://t.me/waenhancerx) [![Telegram](https://telegram-badge.pages.dev/api/telegram-badge?channelId=@waenhancerxhub&label=WaEnhancerX%20Hub&showOnline=true)](https://t.me/waenhancerxhub) [![License: Apache Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Active%20Development-success.svg)](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX) [![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md) **[Latest Release](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/releases/latest)** · **[Telegram Community](https://t.me/waenhancerx)** · **[Documentation](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)** · **[Report Bug](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/issues)**
--- ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/chart?repos=waenhancerx/waenhancerx&type=date&legend=top-left)](https://www.star-history.com/?repos=waenhancerx%2Fwaenhancerx&type=date&legend=top-left) --- ## Contents - [Star History](#star-history) - [Why WaEnhancerX](#why-waenhancerx) - [About V2 Architecture](#about-v2-architecture) - [Key Features](#key-features) - [Compatibility & Supported Clients](#compatibility--supported-clients) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Installation Guide](#installation-guide) - [Building from Source](#building-from-source) - [Architecture & Design Principles](#architecture--design-principles) - [Contributors](#contributors) - [Community & Policies](#community--policies) - [Important Notice & Disclaimer](#important-notice--disclaimer) - [License](#license) --- ## Why WaEnhancerX Most WhatsApp modifications require replacing your official application with suspicious, closed-source third-party repackaged APKs. These third-party APKs pose major account security risks, break safety attestation, and often bundle unwanted bloatware or trackers. **WaEnhancerX takes the native Xposed framework approach:** - **Zero Client Tampering:** Works directly on top of the unmodified, genuine WhatsApp client from Google Play. - **Deep System-Level Integration:** Injects settings natively into WhatsApp's internal preferences screen with full search engine support. - **Dynamic CSS Theme Engine:** Style message bubbles, action bars, backgrounds, and UI layouts without decompiling or patching XML assets. - **Local History and Exports:** Stores preserved-message history and media exports on the device. Network-dependent features and update checks have their own settings and behavior. --- ## About V2 Architecture The public manager and hooks use Kotlin/Java, Jetpack Compose, Hilt and Android framework APIs. Features are grouped into packages inside `:app`, with a required private `:licensing` module. The [architecture guide](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) maps the implemented components and their responsibilities. The APK declares `minSdk 24` and `targetSdk 36`. These build settings do not imply that every feature has been verified on every Android version or future host release. Compatibility depends on the target APK, loaded hook framework and individual hook behavior. --- ## Key Features
### 🛡️ Privacy & Security - **Anti-Delete Protection:** Prevent incoming messages from disappearing when sender deletes them. - **View-Once Tools:** Controls for viewing and exporting view-once media on compatible host builds. - **Self-Delete History:** Maintain local archives of messages you delete for yourself. - **Receipt Control:** Granular control over blue ticks and delivered receipts. ### 🎨 Customization & UI - **CSS-like View Engine:** Fine-tune bubble colors, radiuses, and backgrounds with declarative rules. - **Meta AI Cleanup:** Hide intrusive Meta AI icons, floating action buttons, and chat entries. - **Material You (Monet):** Dynamic color theming aligned with system wallpaper palettes. ### ⚡ System & Integration - **Native Settings Injection:** Integrated right inside WhatsApp’s official settings hierarchy. - **Built-in Search:** Instantly locate any tweak via native search bar indexing. - **Safe Restart Policy:** Graceful, reliable WhatsApp process restart directly from the dashboard. - **Tasker Integration:** Open a selected WhatsApp chat through the supported, user-confirmed automation flow.
--- ## Compatibility & Supported Clients WAEX targets exact package names and evaluates configured version-name rules before initializing its feature registry. | Target package | Client | Scope of the declaration | |---|---|---| | `com.whatsapp` | WhatsApp Messenger | Declared target; version rules and feature-specific acceptance still apply. | | `com.whatsapp.w4b` | WhatsApp Business | Declared target; version rules and feature-specific acceptance still apply. | | Other explicitly listed packages | Alternative clients | Exact allowlist membership only; no authenticity or compatibility guarantee. | See the [Client Compatibility Guide](docs/client-compatibility.md) for the actual allowlist, built-in/custom rules, explicit bypass and unavailable-input states. A matching rule or a green source test does not prove that every feature works. --- ## Requirements 1. A rooted Android device with a working Xposed-compatible framework such as LSPosed, configured for that device. 2. An installed target client listed in the module's scope and admitted by its configured version rules. 3. An Android version allowed by the APK's declared minimum SDK (currently API 24), plus framework and target-client compatibility. This is not a device test matrix. The [manifest](app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml) declares the Xposed metadata and [arrays.xml](app/src/main/res/values/arrays.xml) declares the recommended scope. --- ## Installation Guide 1. **Download:** Select the desired Debug or Release APK from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/releases) and read that release's notes. 2. **Install:** Install the APK on the Android device. 3. **Activate:** Enable WaEnhancerX in the loaded framework's manager. 4. **Set scope:** Enable **WaEnhancerX** (`com.waenhancer`) and the installed target, such as `com.whatsapp` or `com.whatsapp.w4b`. System Framework (`android`) is not part of the declared scope in this source tree. 5. **Restart and inspect:** Restart the selected processes as required by the framework, open the WAEX manager, and inspect its compatibility and injection diagnostics. Then check the configured entry point in the target app. The current build configuration enables code minification and resource shrinking for Release. Debug uses a different optimization configuration; it is still an APK archive. A feature working in Debug must also be checked in optimized Release before a release-specific issue is considered resolved. --- ## Building from Source The repository currently declares SDK 36, JDK/toolchain 17, Android Gradle Plugin 9.0.1 and a Gradle distribution of 9.1.0 in the wrapper properties. Use an Android Studio version compatible with that AGP release. The Kotlin catalog entry is 2.0.20; the resolved Gradle plugin/compiler version also depends on AGP and should be recorded when validating a full build. **A public clone alone cannot produce the configured APK.** Both Debug and Release require the private `:licensing` module and the original configured signing key; the build verifies its certificate during configuration. The current revision declares a licensing URL in `.gitmodules` but contains no gitlink or pinned licensing commit, so recursive submodule initialization alone cannot supply it. Builders with access must obtain it separately: ```bash git clone https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX.git cd WaEnhancerX git clone https://github.com/mubashardev/waex-licensing.git licensing ``` Before building, select a compatible licensing revision supplied by the maintainers and record both commit SHAs. Configure the Android SDK and authorized signing properties as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), then run: ```bash ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug ``` The configured output is `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/WaEnhancerX-v_debug.apk`; Release uses `app/build/outputs/apk/release/WaEnhancerX-v_release.apk`. `VERSION_NAME` comes from [gradle.properties](gradle.properties). Public-source checks can run without the private module or signing key. See [Development Setup and Tests](CONTRIBUTING.md#development-setup) for prerequisites, commands and the distinction between source QA, local unit tests and device tests. --- ## Architecture & Design Principles The manager uses `WaexPreferenceManager` and `PreferenceSchema`; injected features read settings through `PreferenceBridgeClient` and `HookProvider`. `MainHook` selects declared targets and invokes `VersionGuard` before `FeatureRegistry` initializes the feature implementations. - [Current architecture and source map](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [Client targeting and version-rule decisions](docs/client-compatibility.md) - [Preference stores, backups and provider authorization](docs/preference-architecture.md) These documents describe the public code. They distinguish implemented behavior from historical design proposals and from checks requiring a full APK or device. --- ## Contributors Thank you to everyone who has contributed code, reported issues, tested builds, or improved the documentation for WaEnhancerX! #WaEnhancer X **Android 版 WhatsApp 的 UI 定制、自动化和隐私引擎** WaEnhancer X 是一款适用于 root Android 的开源 Xposed/LSPosed 模块，可通过隐私控制、防删除恢复、一次性查看媒体工具、界面自定义和生产力功能来增强 WhatsApp 和 WhatsApp Business，而无需重新打包官方应用程序。 👉 [![源代码](https://img.shields.io/badge/Source_Code-GitHub-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX) 👈 [![Android 平台](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Android%20API%2024%2B-3DDC84?style=flat&logo=android&logoColor=white)](https://developer.android.com) [![框架](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framework-LSPosed%20%7C%20Zygisk-orange?style=flat)](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPosed) [![WaEnhancerX 下载](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/total.svg?label=GitHub%20Downloads&color=blue)](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/releases) [![LSPosed 存储库下载](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/xposed-Modules-Repo/com.waenhancer/total.svg?label=LSPosed%20Repo%20Downloads&color=purple)](https://github.com/xposed-Modules-Repo/com.waenhancer/releases) [![电报](https://telegram-badge.pages.dev/api/telegram-badge?channelId=@waenhancerx&label=WaEnhancerX%20Updates&showOnline=true)](https://t.me/waenhancerx) [![电报](https://telegram-badge.pages.dev/api/telegram-badge?channelId=@waenhancerxhub&label=WaEnhancerX%20Hub&showOnline=true)](https://t.me/waenhancerxhub) [![许可证：Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](许可证) [![开发状态](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Active%20Development-success.svg)](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX) [![欢迎 PR](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md) **[最新版本](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/releases/latest)** · **[Telegram 社区](https://t.me/waenhancerx)** · **[文档](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)** · **[报告错误](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/issues)** --- ## 明星历史 [![明星历史图表](https://api.star-history.com/chart?repos=waenhancerx/waenhancerx&type=date&legend=top-left)](https://www.star-history.com/?repos=waenhancerx%2Fwaenhancerx&type=date&legend=top-left) --- ## 内容 - [明星历史](#star-history) - [为什么选择 WaEnhancerX](#why-waenhancerx) - [关于V2架构](#about-v2-architecture) - [主要特点](#key-features) - [兼容性和支持的客户端](#compatibility--supported-clients) - [要求](#要求) - [安装指南](#installation-guide) - [从源代码构建](#building-from-source) - [架构与设计原则](#architecture--design-principles) - [贡献者](#contributors) - [社区与政策](#community--policies) - [重要通知和免责声明](#important-notice--disclaimer) - [许可证](#license) --- ## 为什么选择 WaEnhancerX 大多数 WhatsApp 修改都需要用可疑的、闭源的第三方重新打包的 APK 替换您的官方应用程序。这些第三方 APK 会带来重大的帐户安全风险、破坏安全认证，并且经常捆绑不需要的臃肿软件或跟踪器。 **WaEnhancerX 采用原生 Xposed 框架方法：** - **零客户端篡改：** 直接在来自 Google Play 的未经修改的正版 WhatsApp 客户端上运行。 - **深度系统级集成：** 将设置本地注入 WhatsApp 的内部首选项屏幕，并提供完整的搜索引擎支持。 - **动态 CSS 主题引擎：** 设置消息气泡、操作栏、背景和 UI 布局的样式，无需反编译或修补 XML 资源。 - **本地历史记录和导出：** 在设备上存储保留消息历史记录和媒体导出。网络相关的功能和更新检查有自己的设置gs 和行为。 --- ## 关于V2架构 公共管理器和挂钩使用 Kotlin/Java、Jetpack Compose、Hilt 和 Android 框架 API。功能被分组到 `:app` 内的包中，并带有必需的 私有`:licensing`模块。 [架构指南](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) 映射已实现的组件及其职责。 APK 声明“minSdk 24”和“targetSdk 36”。这些构建设置并不意味着 每个功能都已在每个 Android 版本或未来主机上得到验证 释放。兼容性取决于目标 APK、加载的钩子框架和 个体钩子行为。 --- ## 主要特点 <表> ### 🛡️ 隐私与安全 - **防删除保护：** 防止发件人删除传入邮件后邮件消失。 - **查看一次工具：** 用于在兼容主机版本上查看和导出一次查看媒体的控件。 - **自我删除历史记录：** 维护您自己删除的邮件的本地存档。 - **收据控制：** 对蓝色勾号和已交付收据进行精细控制。 ### 🎨 定制和用户界面 - **类似 CSS 的视图引擎：** 使用声明性规则微调气泡颜色、半径和背景。 - **Meta AI 清理：** 隐藏侵入性 Meta AI 图标、浮动操作按钮和聊天条目。 - **Material You（莫奈）：** 动态颜色主题与系统壁纸调色板一致。 ### ⚡ 系统与集成 - **本机设置注入：** 集成在 WhatsApp 的官方设置层次结构中。 - **内置搜索：** 通过本机搜索栏索引立即找到任何调整。 - **安全重启策略：** 直接从仪表板优雅、可靠地重启 WhatsApp 进程。 - **Tasker 集成：** 通过支持的、用户确认的自动化流程打开选定的 WhatsApp 聊天。 --- ## 兼容性和支持的客户端 WAEX 以准确的包名称为目标并评估配置的版本名称规则 在初始化其功能注册表之前。 |目标包|客户|声明范围 | |---|---|---| | `com.whatsapp` | WhatsApp 信使 |宣布的目标；版本规则和特定功能的接受仍然适用。 | | `com.whatsapp.w4b` | WhatsApp 业务 |宣布的目标；版本规则和特定功能的接受仍然适用。 | |其他明确列出的软件包 |另类客户|仅限确切的许可名单成员资格；没有真实性或兼容性保证。 | 具体请参见【客户端兼容性指南】(docs/client-compatibility.md) 白名单、内置/自定义规则、显式绕过和不可用输入状态。 匹配规则或绿色源测试并不能证明每个功能都有效。 --- ## 要求 1. 一台已取得 root 权限的 Android 设备，具有可运行的 Xpose 兼容框架，例如 LSPod，为该设备配置。 2. 已安装的目标客户端列在模块的范围内并由其承认 配置的版本规则。 3. APK声明的最低SDK允许的Android版本（当前API 24）， 加上框架和目标客户端兼容性。这不是设备测试矩阵。 [manifest](app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml) 声明了 Xposed 元数据并 [arrays.xml](app/src/main/res/values/arrays.xml) 声明建议的范围。 --- ## 安装指南 1. **下载：** 从以下位置选择所需的 Debug 或 Release APK [GitHub 版本](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/releases) 并阅读 该版本的注释。 2. **安装：** 在 Android 设备上安装 APK。 3. **激活：** 在加载的框架管理器中启用 WaEnhancerX。 4. **设置范围：**启用**WaEnhancerX** (`com.waenhancer`) 并安装 目标，例如“com.whatsapp”或“com.whatsapp.w4b”。系统框架（`android`） 不属于此源树中声明的范围的一部分。 5. **重新启动并检查：** 根据要求重新启动选定的进程 框架k、打开WAEX管理器，检查其兼容性和注入 诊断。然后检查目标应用程序中配置的入口点。 当前的构建配置可实现代码缩减和资源缩减 用于发布。调试使用不同的优化配置；它仍然是一个APK 存档。在调试中工作的功能还必须在优化的发布中进行检查 在特定于版本的问题被视为已解决之前。 --- ## 从源代码构建 该存储库当前声明 SDK 36、JDK/工具链 17、Android Gradle 插件 9.0.1 和包装器属性中的 Gradle 分布 9.1.0。使用与其兼容的 Android Studio 版本 AGP 发布。 Kotlin 目录条目是 2.0.20；已解决的 Gradle 插件/编译器 版本还取决于 AGP，并且应在验证完整版本时进行记录。 **单独的公共克隆无法生成配置的 APK。** 调试和发布 需要私有`:licensing`模块和原始配置的签名密钥； 构建在配置期间验证其证书。目前的修订版 在 `.gitmodules` 中声明许可 URL，但不包含 gitlink 或固定 许可提交，因此仅递归子模块初始化无法提供它。 具有访问权限的构建者必须单独获取它： ````bash git 克隆 https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX.git cd WaEnhancerX git clone https://github.com/mubahardev/waex-licensing.git 许可 ```` 在构建之前，选择由 维护者并记录两个提交 SHA。配置Android SDK并授权 如 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 中所述签署属性，然后运行： ````bash ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug ```` 配置的输出是 `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/WaEnhancerX-v_debug.apk`;发布用途 `app/build/outputs/apk/release/WaEnhancerX-v_release.apk`。 `VERSION_NAME` 来自 [gradle.properties](gradle.properties)。 公共源代码检查可以在没有私有模块或签名密钥的情况下运行。参见 [开发设置和测试](CONTRIBUTING.md#development-setup) 了解先决条件， 命令以及源 QA、本地单元测试和设备测试之间的区别。 --- ## 架构和设计原则 管理器使用“WaexPreferenceManager”和“PreferenceSchema”；注入特征 通过`PreferenceBridgeClient`和`HookProvider`读取设置。 `主钩子` 选择声明的目标并在“FeatureRegistry”之前调用“VersionGuard” 初始化功能实现。 -
